questions.subject: EUROPEAN_HISTORY
questions.learningObjective: Identify the geographic origin of the Renaissance
questions.stem: A train dispatcher's log notes a cultural revival beginning in Italian city-states around 1300. Which movement began there?

options.text: The Renaissance, rooted in classical revival and urban wealth.
The Reformation, sparked by Luther's theses.

The Romantic movement, focused on emotion and nature.

questions.explanation: The Renaissance emerged in Italian city-states around 1300, drawing on classical antiquity and urban commercial wealth. The other movements belong to later centuries.

questions.explanation: Humanism emphasized classical learning and human dignity. It broadened education beyond theology, though it did not abandon religion.

questions.explanation: Cheaper books and faster transmission broadened literacy and idea exchange. The press did not end religion or centralize monastic control.
